issue_request: FHIR-20513 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I change request for Questionnaire asking to add "Terms of Use" as separate/distinct from "Copyright". The final reopened disposition narrowed the earlier broader metadata-resource proposal to FHIR-I owned resources where the change had already been made, using copyrightLabel for the short footer label and copyright for full licensing, restrictions, warranties, and similar terms.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite 16a6d6f02293fa9e3bf00e8c8b15f6d84b6b7400 and then 98e50d8ce925f98bdd0de6628fc6c0c5469e6f8d for FHIR-I only resources. The first cited merge did not touch Questionnaire or copyrightLabel, while 98e50d8ce925f98bdd0de6628fc6c0c5469e6f8d and PR #2392 added Questionnaire.copyrightLabel and parallel canonical/FHIR-I copyrightLabel elements for R5.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml is current build-scope source. Later FHIR-49012 approved non-substantive copyright/copyrightLabel clarifications and commit 606d8a087698581b7895f3be8ca9b0641c0fa739 updated Questionnaire so copyright is an intellectual-property notice that can include use restrictions, while copyrightLabel is a short footer string whose comment directs full licensing/restriction details to copyright. Seed-specific Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Questionnaire StructureDefinition already contains the requested 0..1 string copyrightLabel adjacent to copyright, and the current definitions distinguish the short label from full licensing/use restrictions. Additional Questionnaire-local prose for FHIR-20513 would duplicate adjacent element guidance rather than change implementer understanding.
